_readme: Hand-maintained overrides applied on top of the scraped NYSE calendar.
utils/nyse/build-nyse-hours.mjs READS this file and never writes it, so the daily job cannot clobber your edits.
Use it for things the published holiday calendar cannot know in advance: national days of mourning, weather closures, technical outages, delayed opens.
Add an entry, commit, and GitHub Pages picks it up on the next build (~1 minute). Run the workflow manually (Actions -> NYSE hours -> Run workflow) to refresh the derived JSON immediately.
type: 'closed' | 'early_close' (optional coreClose HH:MM, default 13:00) | 'delayed_open' (optional coreOpen HH:MM) | 'note' (annotate without changing hours).
Times are wall-clock America/New_York. Always include a source URL — the page renders it.

_examples.reason: National day of mourning for President Jimmy Carter
